middleHonesty: Middle is a texture-resolution LOD using the existing 256px source and the same coarse geometry as far. It is not a separately simplified geometric middle or renamed duplicate.
materialPolicy: Six existing glTF material identities remain separate; same-material primitives are merged. Materials/PBR, samplers and image bytes are unchanged. Missing source UVs get zeros only on untextured primitives; all existing UV values are exact.
runtimeLimit: Current 1628090 CPU geometry path was replayed, not GPU/UI or automatic mid-distance selection. Website integrator owns actual 3-tier switching and final deployment verification.
